question: Which monument of Khilji dynasty in Delhi has the utilization of red sandstone?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alai Darwaza**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alai Darwaza **is a monument built during **the Khilji dynasty in Delhi **and it is made of red sandstone.
 
• The monument was built by Alauddin Khilji in 1311 AD and it served as the main entrance to the Qutub Complex.
 
• The architecture of the monument is a blend of Islamic and Hindu styles and it is decorated with intricate carvings and calligraphy.
 
• The Alai Darwaza is considered as one of the finest examples of Indo-Islamic architecture in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Victoria Memorial is a monument located in Kolkata, West Bengal, and it was built during the British Raj in memory of Queen Victoria.
 
• Charminar is a monument located in Hyderabad, Telangana, and it was built during the Qutb Shahi dynasty in 1591 AD. It is made of granite and limestone.
 
• Moti Masjid is a mosque located in the Red Fort complex in Delhi and it was built by Mughal emperor Aurangzeb in the 17th century. It is made of white marble.
